description: Post-AU tranche. Unified arena on AoS substrate (AU.6.7) replaced per-type payload side-car Vecs with a single arena; ten push_leaf_with_* methods collapsed into one push_leaf_with(kind, PayloadData). ParsedGrammar deleted (AU.4.1; 11-tranche deferral resolved). StructRegistry deleted (AU.4.2). generated.rs matches fresh regen; module-level #![allow] (AU.4.3). Branch classification fixed for nested Alt-of-leaves (AU.1). Grammar-wide W1 annotation audit landed (CSS L4, JSON, BBNF, Sheets). HexConvert routed through tape-first emitter (AU.2.4). AU.2.7 structural bitmap subsumed memchr1/2/3 + nibble_lut. @debug * wildcard fix (AU.4.6). number -> f64 dispatch fixed (strict-vs-permissive leading-dot). Borrow-safe JSON strings skip arena copy. 58 typed-parity tests pinned (10 ignored for variant-dispatch / InlineScalar migration gaps routed to AV).
bench_matrix_note: Cold per-parse only (mimalloc). Four bench suites per tranche README completion requirements; VM, WASM, TS, and competitor benches excluded. The google_sheets_monolithic bench includes 2 format_* entries (listed under format/) in addition to the 3 parse_* entries specified in the README matrix.

json_monolithic.note: Tape-only parse (direct-to-struct; strings land borrow-safe when escape-free, arena-copied otherwise). NOT apples-to-apples with sonic-rs::Value; see json_monolithic_value bench for honest parity (not part of the four-bench close-out matrix).

gate_1_json_value_number_leaf_f64.evidence: commit 83357e4: push_leaf_with_f64 fires on JSON __value number branch (W5 substrate folds this into push_leaf_with(PayloadData::WideScalar))

gate_2_json_value_bool_leaf_bool.evidence: Only the `false` branch fires (alt-payload first-branch loss — typed-parity-audit Bug 1). Routes to AV.

gate_3_json_value_null_leaf_u8.evidence: Single-branch rule; payload writes reliably via InlineScalar.

gate_5_css_number_f64_activation.evidence: commit 63f86a5: `number -> f64` restored; commit 240535b: dispatch by allow_leading_dot (scan_number_f64 generic vs scan_number_strict_f64).

gate_6_css_hex_u32_activation.evidence: commit 2bd75a3: HexConvert routes through tape-first emitter; parse_hex_color emits twice in expand; push_leaf_with_aggregate fires at 20+ sites (post-W2).

gate_7_css_ident_config_routing.evidence: PROGRESS Session 1 correction: 7 of 8 `scan_ident` call sites correctly use DEFAULT_IDENT_CONFIG — the CSS `ident` regex does not admit leading dash; only `selectorIdent` needs CSS_IDENT_CONFIG, which it receives. Original audit claim was incorrect.

gate_8_css_dimensions_aggregate.evidence: Activated via AU.2.5 Ref-projection + join_types fix (commits 558a457, 05e38dc). `push_leaf_with_aggregate` sites grew 2→20→27 post-W3. Per typed-parity-audit, multi-branch unit rules exhibit Bug 1 (alt-payload first-branch only fires). Single-branch percentageUnit / flexUnit reliably fire.

gate_9_css_color_families_roundtrip.evidence: hex round-trip landed (W2.B + test ff30e16). namedColor 113/148 branches fire (factor-pass payload loss). colorFunction / colorFn / colorMix aggregate payloads did NOT land (AU.2.6 emitter extension not shipped).

gate_10_json_value_bench_walks_tape.evidence: commits de51346 + 39aa0d0 + aa778c8: json_monolithic_value walker consumes ChildIter; payload_string skips UTF-8 check on hot path. 7 JSON variant-dispatch parity tests ignored post-W5/W6.D due to walker variant_idx dispatch break against the new tape shape.

gate_11_bbnf_sonic_ratio_post_decode.evidence: Post-W6.D: canada ratio 0.61 (target 0.80), twitter 0.52 (target 0.60). Residual is parse-stage (Eisel-Lemire, simdjson-scale SIMD decode). Walker side is zero-alloc with borrow-safe strings.

gate_12_every_arrow_reaches_tape.evidence: Systemic Bug 1 (alt-lit first-branch-only payload write) + Bug 2 (-> Span shorthand lowers to push_compound) documented in typed-parity-audit.md. BBNF: 4 sites in source, 0 firing at runtime. Sheets: 9 sites, majority lose the second-branch payload. CSS: 31 Aggregate writes vs ~600+ declared alt branches.

gate_13_no_comment_push_compound.evidence: AU.6.9 `big_comment -> Span` leaf-optimisation was not shipped — `-> Span` lowers to push_compound under Bug 2 anyway.

gate_14_no_map_unit_discard.evidence: commit 4e4a75e: .map(|_| ()) eliminated at every codegen site (309 sites → 0); W3.C verified grep -cF '.map(|_| ())' == 0 on every expand artifact.

gate_15_parsed_grammar_eliminated.evidence: commit 688d6ea: ParsedGrammar deleted; GrammarSink trait + PipelineSink / ExtractSink replace the flat-Vec intermediate. 11-tranche deferral resolved.

gate_16_payload_idx_eliminated_singular_.evidence: commit 3b75463 + 9a1186e: TapeRec::payload_idx field removed (slot is _reserved: u16 for future packing). Every payload_*: Vec<_> side-car on Tape deleted. Single push_leaf_with(kind, PayloadData) entry point; thin push_leaf_with_arena_frame helper retained for the decode-kernel stream path.

gate_17_workspace_compiles_zero_errors_n.evidence: Compiles zero errors. Default `cargo test --workspace` exits 101 on the single pre-existing imports failure (matches the plan expectation). Under --no-fail-fast: 967 pass / 33 fail / 30 ignored. Breakdown: 4 CSS tape_parity goldens stale post-W6.D (4df6b8c regenerated only json/sheets), 5 sheets_parity Bug-1 pinned-assert tests flipped PASS→FAIL under W6.D scalar-bypass (missed #[ignore] marking during W6.C integration), 23 pre-existing Session-1 '18 tests fail' family hidden by cargo's stop-at-first behaviour, 1 pre-existing imports failure.

gate_18_generated_rs_matches_fresh_regen.evidence: commits 6e33a40 (W1), c9a4fc7 (W2), 5b2a48e (W3), 28f5023 (W4.B); bootstrap idempotent (diff = 0 across consecutive clean-cache regens per PROGRESS W5/W6).

gate_19_fresh_samply_profiles_27_pairs.evidence: profiling-2.md — 27 (bench, entry) pairs captured with seven required artefacts each (bench.txt, build.txt, record.txt, load.txt, profile.json.gz, profile.json.syms.json, syms-proof.txt). 19 profile sub-directories under .profiles/samply/prebuild/ in master.

gate_20_padded_input_every_simd_kernel.evidence: parse-that commit 64fe9f2 landed padded_bytes() on ParserState and converted four scanner kernels. Not every kernel has dropped its internal bounds guards yet — routed as a kernel opt-in cascade to AV (PROGRESS W3.A follow-up 6).

gate_21_json_canada_decoded_1800_mbps.evidence: canada 1231 MB/s on the tape-only path (with payload_f64 storage); the decoded value path via json_monolithic_value stabilises at 0.61 ratio vs sonic. Raw canada dropped 1796 → 1294 → 1231 from AQ to post-AU as the cost of activating f64 payload writes (see PROGRESS Session 1 'unverified claim' section for uninvestigated delta).
gate_21_json_canada_decoded_1800_mbps.routing: AV (needs Eisel-Lemire optimisation + simdjson-scale SIMD decode)

gate_22_css_bootstrap_600_mbps.evidence: bootstrap 454 MB/s (this run); residual is __declaration (38% self) + __compoundSelector (31%) — AV-scale PHF + SIMD selector classifier. W6.D tier-2 inlined WS fastpath landed 438 MB/s; noise puts this run at 454.

gate_23_css_bootstrap_550_after_aggregat.evidence: AU.2.6 colorFunction / colorFn / colorMix aggregate payloads did not ship; the dimension-aggregate activation from AU.2.5 landed but bootstrap never reached the 600 baseline, so the regression-budget gate is not applicable.

gate_24_sheets_parse_simple_200_mbps.evidence: parse_simple 95 MB/s. AU.6.3 Pratt precedence-tower flattening was not shipped; the six-level left-recursive tower still emits unconditional mark_children + push_compound at every level. Per-grammar TapeBuilder capacity (W3.B) contributed +5% from 78 → 95; the structural lever is AV.

default_cargo_test_workspace.note: cargo test --workspace stops at first failing test binary. Exit 101 matches the tranche-plan expectation. The 33 full failure count below is surfaced only via --no-fail-fast.

landed_tests.honesty_note: The tranche plan expected 'exit 101 with 1 failing test plus 10 #[ignore]s'. Default cargo test produces exactly that. Under --no-fail-fast the genuine picture is 967/33/30 — 33 real failures hidden by cargo's stop-at-first behaviour. The 4 css tape_parity failures surface stale goldens that W6.D's test regen commit (4df6b8c) missed (it only regenerated json/sheets goldens). The 5 sheets_parity first-branch tests are Bug 1 pinned assertions that flipped from PASS to FAIL once W6.D's scalar-bypass landed; their `assert` was intended to flip with the Bug 1 fix but was not explicitly marked #[ignore]. The remaining 23 failures are pre-existing Session-1 '18 tests fail' family (closures, debug, imports, lower, analysis, gorgeous).

av_seeds.bug_1_alt_payload_first_branch_loss: Per typed-parity-audit §Bug 1: Alt-bodied rules with literal alternatives carrying typed payloads fire the payload-write block on only ONE branch. Concrete instance: JSON `bool` fires only `false`; every CSS Nu8 unit rule (absoluteLengthUnit, angleUnit, …), every *Keyword rule, and every Sheets Nu8 op (compare_op, add_op, mul_op, unary_prefix) lose second-branch payloads. Surgical fix: hoist the `__has_payload = true` write out of the per-branch closure in `crates/core/src/backend/rust/emitter/grammar.rs`'s alt-lit emission path.
av_seeds.bug_2_span_shorthand_lowers_to_compound: Per typed-parity-audit §Bug 2: `-> Span` shorthand and `-> input : Span` reach IR as TypeDesc::Named("Span") which the rule-body emitter does not route through PayloadData::Aggregate(8 bytes). Every BBNF token rule (identifier, literal, regex, big_comment, comment, string_lit) and every Sheets `-> input : Span` rule (string, cell_ref, identifier) emit push_compound with no payload. Fix: admit TypeDesc::Named("Span") to the leaf-payload route (the KvPair whitelist landed in W2.B; extend to bare-Span). Bug 2b (`-> i64`/`-> f64` scanner-to-payload wiring) is larger — parse_that scan_*_mut must return Option<f64>/Option<i64> threaded into the alt prelude. AV-substrate scope.
av_seeds.css_bootstrap_438_to_600_mbps: Post-AU CSS bootstrap is 454 MB/s; the residual cost sits on __declaration (38% self) + __compoundSelector (31%). AV-scale remediation: PHF property name dispatch + SIMD selector classifier over the structural bitmap. Structural bitmap kernel (AU.2.7) is in place as the substrate for the classifier.
av_seeds.json_sonic_ratio_0.61_to_0.80: AU.3.2 ratio plateaued at canada 0.61 / twitter 0.52 after walker zero-alloc + borrow-safe strings. Residual is parse-stage Eisel-Lemire + simdjson-scale SIMD decode. AV substrate work: widen scan_number_mantissa integer fastpath, NEON fractional, and integrate with the scanner dispatch so string-decode + number-parse share the padded-input SIMD pipeline.
av_seeds.sheets_parse_simple_95_to_200_mbps: Sheets precedence-tower flattening (AU.6.3 Pratt lowering) was not shipped. Six-level left-recursive tower contributes 56–86% self-time. Replace with a single Pratt-style loop in __expr dispatching on operator precedence via a lookahead byte match. Pattern generalises to CSS value expressions and BBNF binary expressions. AV scope.
av_seeds.soa_columnar_substrate: W4 columnar prototype measured 1.94× on sum-all-f64 (gate was ≥ 5×); AU.6.7 unified arena landed on AoS. Key finding: strict-IEEE f64 left-fold blocks LLVM auto-vectorisation; 4-lane reordered unrolling clears the gate at 6.64×. The SoA layout is necessary-but-not-sufficient; the emitter-side reordering pattern is the additional AV lever.
av_seeds.variant_dispatch_walker_coherence: 7 JSON parity tests ignored post-W5/W6.D because walker variant_idx dispatch broke under the unified-arena tape shape. View-layer coherence fix alongside the Bug 1 emitter work. Trivial once Bug 1 lands since variant_idx re-anchors to the per-branch payload writes.
av_seeds.test_selective_transitive_unfurling: Pre-existing imports.rs failure, orthogonal to AU scope but surfaced during W6 triage. W6.A and W6.B both flagged it. Defer to a dedicated imports-subsystem pass; not an AU regression.
